category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: One command to start a ledger
history.description: `ledger init` turns any existing project into one that keeps a feature ledger: it creates the `.ledger/` directory with everything the record needs — the product's settings, its branding, the release timeline, and the folder the features themselves live in — points the project's coding-agent instructions at it, and keeps the generated documents out of version control. Nothing else has to be arranged by hand before the first feature can be written.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/init.mjs — cmdInit. Writes config.json, brand.json, releases.json, subcategories.json, other-changes.json, index.json, features/ and a README, seeded from DEFAULT_CONFIG / DEFAULT_BRAND in src/store.mjs.
